description: WebRTC layer and React hooks: the four custom hooks (useWebRTC, useSession, useConnectionStatus, useTransferQueue) plus the transfer UI components (TransferProgress, FilePreview, DropZone). These are all 'use client' browser-only modules. Depends on FEAT-001 (types, webrtc lib) and FEAT-002 (API routes for session creation). FEAT-004 (pages/workspace components) depends on these hooks.
steps: Create src/hooks/useConnectionStatus.ts — 'use client'. Tracks connection mode (ONLINE | LOCAL | OFFLINE) and WebSocket readyState. Uses navigator.onLine for baseline, attempts to reach /api/health to confirm online status, falls back to LOCAL if health check fails but WebSocket connects on LAN IP. Exports { mode: ConnectionMode, isOnline: boolean, wsConnected: boolean }. Updates on window online/offline events.

Create src/hooks/useSession.ts — 'use client'. Manages session lifecycle: createSession(durationMinutes) calls POST /api/session/create, stores { sessionId, token, pairCode, pairCodeFormatted, qrDataUrl, expiresAt } in sessionStorage (key: 'ocp_session'), destroySession() calls POST /api/session/destroy + clears sessionStorage + calls wsRef.send destroy message, joinSession(code) resolves session by pairCode. Returns { session, isLoading, error, createSession, destroySession, joinSession, sessionStatus }. On mount, restore session from sessionStorage if not expired.

Create src/hooks/useWebRTC.ts — 'use client'. Core hook. Manages WebSocket signaling connection and RTCPeerConnection. Parameters: { sessionId, token, role: 'pc'|'phone' }. (1) Opens WebSocket to NEXT_PUBLIC_WS_URL on mount, sends 'join' message. (2) On 'paired' message, initiates WebRTC handshake: PC role creates offer, phone role waits for offer then creates answer. (3) Relays offer/answer/ice-candidate via WebSocket. (4) On DataChannel open, sets isConnected=true. (5) Handles peer-disconnected: attempts reconnect up to 3 times with 2s backoff. (6) On unmount, closes WebSocket and PeerConnection. Returns { isConnected, isPaired, send(data: string|ArrayBuffer), onMessage(handler), connectionState, reconnecting }. Uses PeerConnection and DataChannel classes from src/lib/webrtc/. CRITICAL: never instantiate RTCPeerConnection at module level — only inside useEffect after mount.

Create src/hooks/useTransferQueue.ts — 'use client'. Manages the queue of pending/active/completed transfers. State: transfers: Map<string, TransferState>. Methods: enqueue(file: File, sendFn): void — generates transferId (uuid v4), adds to queue, starts sending via DataChannel. updateProgress(transferId, bytesTransferred): void. complete(transferId): void. cancel(transferId): void. receiveFileMeta(meta: FileMeta): void. receiveChunk(header, data): void — buffers chunks, assembles when complete, creates object URL for download. Returns { transfers, enqueue, cancel, activeCount }.

Create src/components/transfer/TransferProgress.tsx — 'use client'. Displays a transfer item: filename, size, progress bar (percentage), speed (bytes/sec), cancel button (if sending), download button (if received and complete), status badge (queued/sending/receiving/complete/failed/cancelled). Props: transfer: TransferState, onCancel: (id: string) => void. Use Tailwind for styling — progress bar should animate smoothly.
Create src/components/transfer/FilePreview.tsx — 'use client'. Renders file preview based on MIME type: images → with object URL, PDFs →

Create src/components/transfer/DropZone.tsx — 'use client'. Full drag-and-drop file upload area. States: idle, dragover, uploading. On drop: validates file size (MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB from env, default 100MB), validates MIME type via isAllowedMimeType(), calls onFilesSelected(files: File[]). Also renders a hidden <input type='file' multiple> triggered by click. Shows allowed file types and size limit. Props: onFilesSelected: (files: File[]) => void, disabled?: boolean. Accessible: role='button', aria-label, keyboard handler for Enter/Space.
acceptance_criteria: useWebRTC hook never references RTCPeerConnection outside of useEffect (browser-only safety)
useSession restores session from sessionStorage on mount if not expired
TransferProgress renders a progress bar and cancel/download buttons correctly
DropZone accepts drag-and-drop and rejects files exceeding MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB
FilePreview renders images as , PDFs as
npm run type-check passes after this FEAT
npm run build completes without errors
verification: npm run build — Next.js build succeeds (this validates all 'use client' boundaries are correct)
findings: All 7 files created successfully. npm run type-check passes with zero errors. npm run build succeeds and generates public/sw.js (PWA service worker). npm test passes 88 tests (all pre-existing from FEAT-001/002). Key notes: (1) useWebRTC uses dynamic import() inside createPeerConnection callback (which itself only runs inside useEffect) — RTCPeerConnection is never touched at module level, satisfying SSR safety. (2) ICE candidates are queued in iceCandidateQueueRef before remote description is set, then flushed atomically after setRemoteDescription. (3) WebSocket reconnects up to 3 times with 2^attempt * 2000ms exponential backoff — for both WS close events and peer-disconnected messages. (4) useSession stores session under 'ocp_session' in sessionStorage and restores on mount if not expired. (5) DropZone validates MIME types via isAllowedMimeType() and file size against MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB (env var, default 100MB). Accessible via role=button, aria-label, keyboard Enter/Space. (6) FilePreview imports only 5 Prism languages (javascript, typescript, python, css, json). (7) Side fix: next.config.ts was renamed/converted to next.config.js since Next.js 14.2.18 does not support next.config.ts. The NetworkOnly rule for /api/* was added as the first runtimeCaching entry per plan.md recommendation.
